purpose: The standing queue of improvement requests for Ty's Assistant. The continuous loop executes task contracts and never invents scope, so an empty queue stops it. This file is where work is written down before it is runnable, so a campaign never starts from nothing.

statuses.ready: write_paths and a verification are named; tools/improvement_backlog.py --promote can turn it into a loop task contract
statuses.needs-author: a real defect with evidence, but the write scope or the design is not settled; an author must finish it before it can run
statuses.blocked: waiting on an operator decision, a spend gate, or a file outside the loop's commit allowlist
statuses.done: shipped and verified; keep the entry with its commit
statuses.promoted: already written into config/continuous_loop_tasks.json; the supervisor owns it now

rules.promotion: only 'ready' items may be promoted. Promotion writes a card into config/continuous_loop_tasks.json and validates it with continuous_loop.validate_task before the file is touched.
rules.evidence: every item cites the file and line that shows the problem. An item without evidence is an opinion, not a request.

items.title: The authored prompt reaches the evidence runners but not the API render path
items.problem: CORRECTED 2026-11-05: the original entry claimed nothing calls prompt_author. That was wrong - tools/run_flow_formats.py authors per-format prompts through prompt_author.author_prompt and passes them into CreativeFlow, and tools/run_flow_e2e.py supplies a literal. The real gap is narrower: the API/studio render path (studio_generation.generate_image and its callers) builds prompts inline and never authors or refines them, so a user prompt that violates the plate contract is rendered as-is.
evidence: Northstar_backend/studio_generation.py:736 - generate_image(prompt, ...) takes the string as given
items.proposed_change: Decide the contract for the API path before wiring: a clean-plate render must refuse type terms, but a label/concept render legitimately contains them, so a single refinement cannot apply to both. Either add a plate-only refinement at the generate_image call sites that ask for blank plates, or leave the API unrefined and say so.
items.verification: test_creative_flow.py and test_prompt_author.py stay green; a new case proves a disarmed author blocks the run.
items.blocked: needs a decision on which render paths are plate-only, because refine_prompt would strip legitimate text from a label concept

items.title: Show the dieline guides that are already implemented
items.problem: src/lib/dielineOverlay.js implements multi-panel geometry and normalised bleed/trim/fold/safe guides, with a passing test, and no page imports it. Dielines.jsx renders the dieline SVG with no guides at all, so the operator cannot see where bleed and folds land.
evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/lib/dielineOverlay.test.js - the only file that references the module
northstar-os-ui/src/pages/internal/design-studio/Dielines.jsx:16 - imports do not include the overlay
items.proposed_change: Render guidesForPanel() over the dieline preview in Dielines.jsx, DOM-only, so a guide can never reach the exported SVG or PDF (the module's own contract). Add a toggle and keep the existing download paths byte-identical when it is off.
items.verification: npm run build 0 errors; npm run test:ui green; test_frontend_gate.py green; exported SVG bytes unchanged with the overlay off.

items.title: Say when the Ty panel data was last good
items.problem: TysOpsPanel polls /api/admin/tys/* every 5 s and shows a live/unavailable pill, but never says when the data on screen was fetched. If polling fails after a successful load, stale queue counts keep rendering under a pill that only flips once the error state is set, and there is no age shown at any point.
evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/internal/TysOpsPanel.jsx:348 - the status pill renders live / unavailable only
items.proposed_change: Record the last successful fetch time, render 'updated Ns ago', and mark the panel stale after three missed polls while keeping the last values visible and clearly aged.
items.verification: npm run build 0 errors; npm run test:ui green; test_frontend_gate.py green.

items.title: Keep Package Design sessions across navigation
items.problem: PackifyDesign holds its session list in component state only. Leaving the page discards every generated concept, so an operator who generates three designs and clicks into Design Studio comes back to an empty workspace.
evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/internal/PackifyDesign.jsx - sessions live in useState with no storage or fetch
items.proposed_change: Persist sessions through the existing workspace state helper (src/lib/workspaceState.js) or a local store keyed by account, and restore them on mount. Never fabricate a session that was not generated.
items.verification: npm run build 0 errors; npm run test:ui green with a new case covering restore and the empty state.

items.title: Parameter tuning and best-of-N on the render path
items.problem: generate_image hardcodes steps (16 draft / 24 final) and a fixed CFG of 1.0 in the FLUX 3 graph. image_best_of.py exists and scores candidates, but only tys_assistant.py uses it. A render is a single draw at a random seed with no sweep and no selection.
evidence: Northstar_backend/image_best_of.py - scoring exists, not referenced by studio_generation
items.proposed_change: Expose steps/cfg/seed as bounded parameters and add an opt-in best-of-N that reuses image_best_of scoring, with N capped so a 16 GB card cannot be asked for an unbounded sweep.
items.verification: test_studio_generate_contract.py green; a new case proves N is capped and that a single-render call is unchanged.
items.blocked: author must bound N for a 16 GB card and name the selection threshold before any sweep is allowed to run

items.title: Fit the ad copy to the beat plan instead of truncating it
items.problem: The ad pipeline now measures and reports overrun_s, which makes the truncation visible, but it still drops the tail of the narration. A 3 s ad carrying a 10.4 s script delivers 3 s of speech and says so in the manifest - honest, not fixed.
evidence: Northstar_backend/video_ad.py - strict_overrun=False with overrun_s recorded in the audio block
items.proposed_change: Fit the script to the picture before synthesis: trim to a sentence boundary using the same words-per-second estimate video_script already uses, re-measure, and record both the requested and delivered word counts.
items.verification: test_video_ad.py green including the overrun report; a new case proves a long script is fitted and the delivered overrun is inside tolerance.
items.blocked: author must choose the words-per-second estimator and whether a fitted script is re-synthesised or the beat plan is re-cut

items.title: Record credit consumption so the meter can move
items.problem: /api/v1/credits/me returns consumed:0 and balance == allotment on every call, by design ("offline alpha: no consumption tracked yet"). Nothing debits the ledger, so the balance is decorative and the affordability gate in Package Design can never actually stop a run.
evidence: Northstar_backend/main.py:2404 - "Offline alpha: no consumption tracked yet; balance == allotment"
Northstar_backend/credit_ledger.py:114 - CreditLedger exists with reservations and entries
items.proposed_change: Debit through CreditLedger on the priced actions (AI Design, render, video) and return the real consumed/balance from the endpoint. Keep the existing envelope and the display-only client contract.
items.verification: test_credit_ledger.py green; a new case proves a priced action reduces the balance and an unaffordable one is refused before it runs.
items.blocked: author must name every priced action and the reservation/commit semantics before anything debits a ledger

items.title: Apply the error-state standard to the remaining pages
items.problem: creditMeter.describeError() now maps a transport failure to a named tone and an action, but only Package Design uses it. Improvement.jsx still calls setError(e.message) and renders the raw string, so an operator sees 'Failed to fetch' with no next step.
items.proposed_change: Move describeError into a shared lib (it is not credit-specific), then adopt it in Improvement.jsx and any page still rendering a raw message, with a role=alert block and the action button.
items.verification: npm run build 0 errors; npm run test:ui green; test_frontend_gate.py green.
items.blocked: author must move describeError out of creditMeter.js into a shared lib without breaking its 10 tests

items.title: Decide on Docling for supplier-document ingestion
items.problem: Docling is MIT, local and fills the supplier catalogue / spec sheet ingestion gap that is currently manual. It is absent from shared/provider-suite.json, so the gate refuses it as unknown_tool and no lane may import it.
evidence: reports/emerging_tools_evaluation_20261105.md - licence read from the upstream LICENSE file
Northstar_backend/provider_suite.py --check docling --provider local -> NOT available on local - unknown_tool
items.proposed_change: Operator decision: add a registry entry (lanes local, license MIT, network false) then re-run the gate. shared/ is outside the loop commit allowlist, so the loop cannot do this itself.
items.verification: provider_suite.py --check docling --provider local returns available before any import.
items.blocked: operator decision to add a shared/provider-suite.json entry; the file is outside the loop commit allowlist

items.title: Install Surya for layout and table extraction
items.problem: surya is registered in the provider suite but marked not_installed. It is the ingestion counterpart to RapidOCR: RapidOCR checks text already on a render, Surya reads tables and reading order out of a supplier PDF.
evidence: shared/provider-suite.json - surya: installed=not_installed, license Apache-2.0, lanes local
shared/provider-suite.json - rapidocr note: 'for the render check, not for ingestion'
items.proposed_change: Install into the local lane, verify the licence and the installed marker, then wire it into document ingestion. Requires an install decision and a shared/ edit.
items.verification: provider_suite.py --check surya --provider local returns available; an ingestion case parses a table.
items.blocked: install decision plus a shared/provider-suite.json marker update, both outside the loop commit allowlist

items.title: The provider suite says FLUX 3 weights are missing; they are not
items.problem: shared/provider-suite.json marks flux3_klein as installed="weights_missing", but the gateway reports weights present and a real 512x512 render completed in 30.2 s on 2026-11-05. A stale marker makes the image lane look unavailable and invites a duplicate download or a false refusal.
evidence: reports/creative_activation_20261105.md - gateway /health reports weights.present=true, missing=[]; render succeeded
items.proposed_change: Set installed to "installed" for flux3_klein and re-run provider_suite.py --check flux3_klein --provider local. shared/ is outside the loop commit allowlist, so this needs an operator edit.
items.verification: provider_suite.py --check flux3_klein --provider local reports installed.
items.blocked: shared/provider-suite.json is outside the loop commit allowlist

items.title: Document how to start the media lane without hanging the caller
items.problem: scripts/start-flux3.ps1 starts ComfyUI and the gateway and returns, but a caller that pipes its output (... | Select-Object) waits forever because the children inherit the pipe handle. That looked like a hang for ten minutes during the 2026-11-05 activation and would look like one to the next operator.
evidence: scripts/start-flux3.ps1 - Start-Process for ComfyUI and the gateway, then writes flux3.pids at the end
reports/creative_activation_20261105.md - the pipeline held for 600 s while the services were already healthy
items.proposed_change: Add the operational note to docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md's sibling runbook (or the script header): redirect with *> file, never a pipe; include the start, health-check and stop sequence.
items.verification: the note is present and the start/stop sequence matches scripts/start-flux3.ps1.

checks.name: docs present
cmd: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); sys.exit(0 if 'start-flux3.ps1' in t and '*>' in t else 1)

items.title: A repeatable production-readiness scanner
items.problem: "Production ready" was being judged by hand. Nothing turned it into checks that either find something or do not, so the same defects kept being discovered by accident: an unreachable module, an unlabelled control, a tag counted inside a comment.
evidence: tools/production_readiness_scan.py - 7 checks over the UI and backend
state/probes and the dielineOverlay/serviceGate findings - both found by hand first
items.proposed_change: Ship the scanner and its tests: dead-module, button-no-type (form-scoped), input-unlabelled, img-no-alt, catch-swallowed, placeholder-copy, silent-except, plus declared per-file waivers with a written reason so a structural false positive is reviewable instead of permanent noise.
items.verification: 16 scanner tests green; the scan runs clean on the real tree.

items.title: Give the global controls an accessible name
items.problem: The command palette, the shell command menu, the pinned drawer, Package Design's brief field and the shared GlassInput/Fields controls had no accessible name. A screen reader announces an unnamed text box for the two most-used navigation surfaces in the app.
items.proposed_change: Add aria-label to the standalone inputs, and declare a written waiver on the two passthrough component libraries (Fields.jsx, Glass.jsx) whose accessible name is supplied by the consumer - a waiver is visible in the scan report, so it is reviewable rather than silent.
items.verification: scan input-unlabelled 40 -> 28 with 2 declared waivers; build clean; ui 221; frontend gate 25.

items.title: Label the remaining form controls across the admin and studio pages
items.problem: 21 form controls across 9 pages had no accessible name: the beta-ops filters, the invite form, the admin note, the tester ticket form, the org change reason fields, the memory search, the spreadsheet editor, the Amazon-file edit cells and the search-term filters. A screen reader announces each as an unnamed field.
evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/admin/OrgsList.jsx:131 - reason field with only a placeholder
northstar-os-ui/src/foundation/pages/BetaOps.jsx:108 - state filter with only a placeholder
items.proposed_change: Add aria-label to every remaining unlabelled control. Placeholders are not accessible names; a colour swatch and a metric cell get an interpolated name so each one is distinguishable.
items.verification: scan input-unlabelled 21 -> 0; build clean; ui 221; frontend gate 25.

items.title: Make the readiness scanner stop reporting things that are not defects
items.problem: The first scanner reported 95 findings, most of them wrong: two tags inside comments, seven checkboxes that do have a label via htmlFor placed after the control, two 'todo' status strings read as TODO markers, and 52 broad except handlers that are deliberate resilience. A report that is mostly wrong is a report nobody reads.
evidence: scan 95 -> 1 finding after the fixes; input-unlabelled 40 -> 0 over three cycles
northstar-os-ui/src/pages/admin/OrgsList.jsx:133 - checkbox labelled by a following <label htmlFor>
items.proposed_change: Strip comments before matching tags (colon-guarded so http:// survives); resolve id/htmlFor pairs anywhere in the file; make TODO/FIXME case-sensitive; move silent-except to an opt-in triage list; keep per-file waivers with a written reason visible in the report.
items.verification: 16 scanner tests green; default scan reports 1 finding (the known dead module).

items.title: Decide whether the UI service gate is wired or removed
items.problem: src/lib/serviceGate.js implements a per-service entitlement decision and is imported by nothing and tested by nothing. Its own header says the decision is enforced server-side, so the file currently looks like a safety control the UI does not have. api.entitlements() exists and serviceRegistry.js derives studio.<id> keys, so wiring it is feasible.
items.proposed_change: Either wire canUseService/serviceAccessMap into the service surface (the tab bar or service menu), with a defined denied state, and test it; or delete the module and record that the UI shows no entitlement state. Do not leave it unreachable.
items.verification: if wired: a test proves a denied service is not enterable and shows a reason; if removed: no references remain.
items.blocked: needs a product decision on which surface shows the gate and what a denied service looks like

items.title: Widen the scanner to failures the UI hides
items.problem: Once the first checks were clean the scanner stopped finding anything, which is not the same as the product being sound. Two classes of user-visible failure were invisible to it: an error state that is set and never rendered (the operator sees a page that simply did not change), and an icon-only button with no accessible name (a screen reader says 'button').
evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/App.jsx:316 - mobile tools-sheet close button is icon-only with no name
northstar-os-ui/src/studio/engine/assets.js:179 - a hook returning error state, correctly not flagged
items.proposed_change: Add error-state-unrendered (setError called, state never read) and icon-button-unnamed (icon-only child, no aria-label/title). Both must refuse to guess: a hook with no JSX is not a component, and a {expr} child may render text so it is undecidable, not a finding.
items.verification: 25 scanner tests green; scan reports 1 finding (the known dead module); build clean; ui 221; frontend gate 25.

items.title: Expose subagents, todos and plan mode as callable tools
items.problem: agent_kernel/subagents.py (run_subagents, merge), todos.py (Todos), plan_mode.py (PlanMode) and skills.py (SkillRegistry) are written and tested, and tool_protocol.py exposes none of them. The model has read/write/ast_edit/run and no way to fan out, track a todo list or propose a plan - the three things that most distinguish Claude Code from a script runner.
evidence: Northstar_backend/agent_kernel/subagents.py - run_subagents and merge exist, unreferenced by the protocol
items.proposed_change: Add tool entries for todo, plan and subagent that delegate to the existing modules, with the same budget/policy limits the other tools obey. No new dependency, no gate, no licence question.
items.verification: a protocol test proves each new tool is declared, dispatchable and refused when the budget is exhausted.
items.blocked: author must decide the schema for subagent fan-out (how many, what scope) before it can be dispatched

items.title: Give Ty an MCP client so it can consume external tool servers
items.problem: Ty serves MCP (tools/northstar_mcp_server.py, 6 read-only tools) but cannot consume any MCP server. Every MCP server in the ecosystem - filesystem, git, databases, docs - is unreachable.
items.proposed_change: Add a registry entry (lanes local+cloud, license MIT, network false for stdio servers) then wire a client into the tool protocol. shared/ is outside the loop commit allowlist.
items.verification: provider_suite --check mcp --provider local returns available; a test connects to a stdio server and calls one tool.
items.blocked: needs an operator registry entry for the mcp package (MIT)

items.title: Give Ty search and page extraction with an Amazon refusal
items.problem: Ty cannot read the web as a tool at all. Chrome Connect is a browser controller, not a research tool, and there is no fetch, no extract and no search in tool_protocol.py. This is the whole Perplexity Computer gap.
evidence: upstream LICENSE: trafilatura Apache-2.0, ddgs MIT
items.proposed_change: Register trafilatura (extract) and ddgs (search), then add fetch/search tools that refuse Amazon hosts and lookalikes BEFORE the request and log URL/timestamp/result to the same audit chain Chrome Connect uses.
items.verification: a test proves an Amazon host is refused before any request is made and that a non-Amazon fetch is audited.
items.blocked: needs registry entries plus sign-off on the Amazon refusal and audit design; without both this is a second unguarded path to the web

items.title: Install headroom for context compaction
items.problem: Long agent sessions degrade because nothing compacts context. headroom is already registered (Apache-2.0) and marked not_installed.
items.proposed_change: Install on the local lane, verify the installed marker, wire compaction into the context module.
items.verification: provider_suite --check headroom --provider local returns available; a test proves a long transcript is compacted under budget.
items.blocked: install decision for an already-registered Apache-2.0 tool

items.title: Vet a package against OSV before installing it
items.problem: The adoption gate answers whether a lane MAY use a package (licence, lane, arming). Nothing answers whether the package is MALICIOUS. For an agent with free roam to install things from GitHub and Hugging Face, that is the missing precondition, not a nice-to-have.
evidence: reports/rea_scan_tys_gaps_20261105.md - goose extension_malware_check.rs: OsvChecker.deny_if_malicious queries OSV and fails on MAL-* advisories
Northstar_backend/provider_suite.py - licence/lane/arming only, no supply-chain check
items.proposed_change: Add tools/vet_package.py: query the public OSV API for (name, ecosystem, version), refuse on any MAL-* advisory, print the advisory ids, and allow an OSV_ENDPOINT override for tests. No new dependency - OSV is HTTP. Wire it into the provenance step so every install records a verdict.
items.verification: tests cover: clean package passes, MAL-* refuses with the advisory id, unknown ecosystem is refused not assumed safe, endpoint override works offline.

items.title: Implement the MCP client surface Ty lacks
items.problem: Ty serves MCP and consumes none. python-sdk defines the exact surface needed: ClientSession.initialize/list_tools/call_tool/list_resources/read_resource (session.py:388/651/1278/993/890/912) with StdioServerParameters (stdio.py:94).
items.proposed_change: Register the mcp package (MIT) and implement the client behind the existing tool protocol so external servers appear as tools.
items.verification: a test connects to a local stdio server and calls one tool end to end.
items.blocked: needs an operator registry entry for the mcp package (MIT)
